parent_objective: design a medium-budget matched profile training panel after short-v0 readiness failure
blocked_by: M2230 completed cleanly but quality_floor_profile_pass_count is 0
supersedes: directly routing M2230 checkpoints to measured execution

public_gates: M2232 must freeze medium-v1 matched training budget and keep profiles/seeds comparable
M2232 must preserve actor input contract and no-oracle/no-wheel constraints
M2232 must preserve readiness-floor criteria before any new training
M2232 must not run training, reset, rollout, measured execution, replay, PPO, or private holdout
M2232 must not rank controller families, select a winner, or claim finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns M2230 complete-but-below-floor result into a controlled medium-budget training design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no new training, ranking, paper, finite-window-vs-GRU, or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if medium budget would require profile-specific tuning
stop if readiness floors are weakened to make M2230 look admissible
stop if the branch has reached synthesis cadence before new execution
fallback_plan: route to task-quality/curriculum audit if medium budget cannot be justified
route to materialization if medium design is clean
route to branch synthesis if local-search cadence fires
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2231 routes to medium-budget training design

admission_evidence: M2230 completed all 15 short-v0 runs with finite metrics and no contract failures
M2231 classifies M2230 as complete but below readiness floors rather than comparison-ready
M2231 keeps ranking and self-ID claims blocked
allowed_updates: M2232 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2232 is a training design and does not test causal history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2232; no wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2230 short-v0 public training result and proposed medium-v1 design.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If medium training also fails floors, record it and route to task/curriculum synthesis rather than lowering standards.
allowed_claims: no architecture ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: tests whether M2230 readiness failure is short-budget undertraining under the same public profile panel
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can produce comparison-ready checkpoints only if later medium training passes floors
must_synthesize_if: medium training design cannot preserve matched budgets
medium training would be another weak short-run repeat
the next execution also produces quality_floor_profile_pass_count 0

hypothesis: A medium-v1 matched-budget plan with 32768 steps per seed can test whether M2230 short-v0 readiness failure is undertraining, without profile-specific tuning or claim expansion.
success_criteria: the five trainable profiles are explicit
the seed IDs are explicit and matched across profiles
training remains blocked until a later materialization/run milestone
no ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claim is made
failure_criteria: M2232 weakens readiness floors to reinterpret M2230
M2232 ranks M2230 profiles or selects a winner

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual medium-budget training design based on M2230 readiness-floor audit

decision_rule: M2232 passes if it freezes a medium-v1 matched-budget design without changing profiles, seeds, readiness floors, or actor inputs.
